newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip in bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip in bearish sentiment.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Monday, as sporadic selling weighed down the market, Japanese traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.5 yen to 2.9 yen per kg lower. Benchmark September was off 2.9 yen at 142.0 yen.

The market started the day weaker with bearish sentiment carried over from the previous week. "Despite the yen's weaker tendency, prices edged down, which suggested how bearish the market is," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
"Prices are likely to fall further after the spot April contract broke under 140 yen level," he said.
